toe te zullen dragen
draag u/je toe, draagt je toe

glosses: bepaalde gevoelens voor iets of iemand hebben
To provide (something), to make (something) available for use.

examples.text: to supply money for the war
to supply a furnace with fuel; to supply soldiers with ammunition

glosses: To fill up, or keep full.

examples.text: Rivers are supplied by smaller streams.

glosses: To compensate for, or make up a deficiency of.

examples.text: It was objected against him that he had never experienced love. Whereupon he arose, left the society, and made it a point not to return to it until he considered that he had supplied the defect.

glosses: To serve instead of; to take the place of.

examples.text: Burning ships the banished sun supply.

The sun was set, and Vesper, to supply
 His absent beams, had lighted up the sky.

glosses: To fill temporarily; to serve as substitute for another in, as a vacant place or office; to occupy; to have possession of.

examples.text: A supply of good drinking water is essential.
She said, "China has always had a freshwater supply problem with 20 percent of the world’s population but only 7 percent of its freshwater".

glosses: An amount of money provided, as by Parliament or Congress, to meet the annual national expenditures.
Somebody, such as a teacher or clergyman, who temporarily fills the place of another; a substitute.
Supplely: in a supple manner, with suppleness.

examples.text: His voice was playful and full; his back was bent supply.

[…] the rain struck on her head as she bent supply to the movements of the pony, while it scrambled up the bank to the sheltering trees. For a couple of miles the path ran through woods alive with the varied voices of the rain, […]
She swayed slightly in the gusts, bent supply to them and seemed at one with the force which Straup found so hostile.

Grigory hesitantly took her in his arms to kiss her, but she held him off, bent supply backwards and shot a frightened glance at the windows.
'They'll see!'
'Let them!'
'I'd be ashamed—'
Hoe hebben de zaken zich toegedragen?
examples.translation: Comment les choses se sont-elles passées ?
